_comment: Copy this file to channel-config.json and replace placeholder values. This file is hot-reloaded by the bot on save.

YOUR_CHANNEL_ID_HERE.name: general
YOUR_CHANNEL_ID_HERE.systemPrompt: You are a helpful assistant running in Discord via Claude Code. Respond naturally and concisely.
